name: clef-chrome
description: Moves small Claude-in-Chrome decisions (which element, did it work) to a local Ollama decision model; falls back to Claude whenever it is unsure.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow: Claude's tools run as normal and the local answer is only logged. active: the local answer is used when it is confident.

model.title: Decision model
model.description: An Ollama model with the decision capability.

embed_model.title: Embedding model
embed_model.description: Ranks a large page before the decision model sees it. Empty turns the prefilter off.

gate.title: Gate threshold
gate.description: Below this yes/no score the decision goes back to Claude.

skip_gate_at.title: Skip the gate at
skip_gate_at.description: A choice at least this sure needs no yes/no gate. 1 always gates.

min_margin.title: Minimum margin
min_margin.description: Two candidates closer than this go back to Claude.

timeout_ms.title: Timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: A local request slower than this goes back to Claude.

settle_ms.title: Settle wait (ms)
settle_ms.description: An extra wait after each batch of browser actions, before the page is read.

route.title: Route
route.description: review: every browser action is reviewed by Claude Code. bridge: a routine browse runs over the browser's local Claude in Chrome bridge, with clef-flash's sort as the review; risky or uncertain steps still go the review way. A browse call can ask for either.

bridge_browser.title: Bridge browser
bridge_browser.description: Whose Claude in Chrome bridge to use.

routine_at.title: Routine threshold
routine_at.description: clef-flash must score each grounded action at least this routine for the bridge.

browse.title: Offer the browse tool
browse.description: browse(steps): run several plain steps locally in one Claude turn.

find.title: Answer find locally
find.description: Answer claude-in-chrome find with the local model.

check.title: Offer the check tool
check.description: check(question): a local yes/no about the page.
